solutions.title: Count each number
solutions.strategy: For every value, repeatedly clear its lowest set bit until it becomes zero.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each number can inspect up to its bit length.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output array stores one count for every value from 0 through n.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each output position is computed once in constant time.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output array doubles as the dynamic-programming table.
